title: Metrics Catalog entry — the FE/BE contract (TL-owned, locked)
description: One self-describing metric. PM authors entries to this schema; BE serves them with live values at /api/registry; FE renders them generically. The schema IS the contract — FE and BE cannot drift.

category.description: Groups metrics into one card on the dashboard.

label.description: Short human label shown on the tile.

so_what.description: Why a human should care — the consequence.

insight.description: Optional thresholds. Expressions are a comparator + numeric literal in the metric's unit, e.g. '< 0.25', '> 0.6'.

source.description: Dotted resolver path BE binds to a live value, e.g. 'economy.cache_hit'. Must resolve in the registry engine.
